purpose: Test whether bounded source diversification can discover required sources missed by top-40 Claim lexical retrieval, before adding any within-source structural completion.
interpretation: Batch C exact-evidence Gold is already revealed. This is a post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not blind product evidence.
causalQuestion: Can a fixed lexical routing pool select a more useful and still-bounded set of sources than top-40 Claim ranking, without using Gold, Relation traversal, domain rules or answer-model feedback?

allowedImplementation.production: Add a read-only source-routing API over the existing persistent lexical index. It may hydrate evidence only for the bounded lexical routing pool and must preserve scope, temporal and stale-index fail-closed behavior.
allowedImplementation.selection: Rank sources by the first occurrence of any of their Claims in the existing deterministic lexical order. Select at most 12 sources; guarantee the highest-ranked Claim from each selected source, then fill remaining slots in original lexical order using only selected sources.
allowedImplementation.evaluation: Add an offline fail-closed runner and tests. No Context Pack, Relation, answer model or canonical-state mutation is allowed.

prohibitedSignals: domain-specific keyword lists or source allowlists
post-run quota changes inside the first run

arms.definition: Top 40 persistent lexical Claim candidates; primary comparator.

Take at most 120 Claims in existing lexical order; rank sources by first Claim occurrence; select at most 12 sources; guarantee one highest-ranked Claim per selected source, then fill to at most 40 from those sources in original lexical order.

decisionRules.SOURCE_DISCOVERY_PASS: At S50 SR12_40 required-source recall is >= L40_STRONG, has at least one strict per-question required-source win, zero per-question required-source losses, routing pool <=120, selected sources <=12 and final candidates <=40. Its own required-source recall may fall by no more than 0.05 from S12 to S50.
decisionRules.FULL_CANDIDATE_PASS: SOURCE_DISCOVERY_PASS plus exact-quote recall >= L40_STRONG, zero per-question exact-quote losses, average evidence-closure tokens <=110% of L40, P95 latency <= max(2x L40, L40+50ms), and at least one strict cost advantage: lower average evidence-closure tokens, fewer average lexical candidate records loaded, or lower P95 latency than L40_STRONG.
decisionRules.SOURCE_ONLY_SIGNAL: SOURCE_DISCOVERY_PASS passes but FULL_CANDIDATE_PASS fails. Preserve source routing as a candidate mechanism and start a separately frozen within-source completion experiment; do not integrate online.
decisionRules.NO_SOURCE_BENEFIT: SR12_40 has no strict required-source win over L40_STRONG at S50.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any required-source loss, budget violation, scope/time leakage, stale-index acceptance, non-determinism or first-run overwrite.

stopRules: Do not generate answers or modify Context Pack.
Do not use same-block/same-source expansion in SR12_40; isolate source discovery first.
Do not tune routingPoolBudget, sourceBudget or candidateBudget after reading the first report; create a new contract/run.
Preserve the first report directory and hash; fixes use a new run id.
